facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2015. The respondent filed a proceeding under section 125 Cr.P.C. and the petitioner contested it. The trial court directed the petitioner to pay interim maintenance of Rs.7,000/- per month. The respondent also instituted a suit for restitution of conjugal rights.

legal_principles.principle: A revision filed after an order has attained finality is rendered infructuous.
legal_principles.held: The said order has assailed finality. It is further submitted that the petitioner had also filed a revision against the said order dated 24.04.2017, as rectified by order dated 05.09.2017, passed in Misc. Case No. 751/2015, which was registered as Crl. Revision No. 85/2018, and it has been submitted that in view of the order dated 23.03.2021, passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Dhubri in Crl. Revision No. 39/2017, the revision filed by the petitioner has been rendered infructuous.

legal_principles.principle: A petition for enhancement of maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C. should be filed before the same Court that adjudicated the original petition.
legal_principles.held: It was submitted that as the petition under section 125 Cr.P.C., being Misc. Case No. 751/2015, was adjudicated by the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Dhubri, as per the text of section 127 Cr.P.C., the petition for enhancement ought to have been filed before the same Court.

outcome.final_order: The proceedings under section 127 Cr.P.C. pending before the trial court are quashed.
